in_urdu.name: يسر

historical_references.context: Yusr bint Nu'man was one of the wives of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) in Medina. She was the daughter of Nu'man ibn Abd al-Aas, and was known for her beauty and generosity. She was married to the Prophet (pbuh) after the death of his wife Khawlah bint Hakim.
